title: Shared Melee Slash
description: Peter-approved melee slashes (2026-10-15). Catalog only. Enemy attacks use fx-slash-enemy-red (敵紅小斬, red, top-left → bottom-right). Ally / player melee uses fx-slash-ally-white (友白小斬, white, top-right → bottom-left). Both are 5 frames @ 30 fps, once, ADD blend, origin (0.5, 0.5) near the body center. Scale rule: authored for 128px-tall characters; slashScale = unitDisplayHeight / 128. Smaller units get a proportionally smaller slash. Do not keep 128-scale on small units. DoT / AoE ticks use fx-slash-dot (持續傷害小斬, white X + amber sparks): 4×30 @ 20 fps (~0.2s, about 5/sec), ADD, body center, dotScale = 0.5 × slashScale (half of the ally white slash). Faction sheets are 3×2 grids; the DoT sheet is 2×2. The last listed frame of each sheet is blank. fx-slash-ninja stays the feel-booth 4 primary. Keys 5–7 of the feel booth only preview these three slashes. fx-slash and fx-slash-overhead stay as they are. fx-hit-fire and fx-hit-water live in fx/bullet-hit. fx-hit-electric is not in this wave. sfx-slash-dot is a Sound Effect follow-up and is not in this catalog.

Sheet 216×144 is a 3×2 grid, not a horizontal strip: frame i is column i%3, row floor(i/3). Frame 4 is blank (the slash has exited); the bottom-right cell is unused padding. Catalog only — fx-slash-ninja stays the feel-booth 4 primary; fx-slash and fx-slash-overhead are unchanged.
